algorithm: X.509 issuance with a URI subject alternative name, and PKCS#10 requests
source: OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026 (Library: OpenSSL 3.5.7 9 Jun 2026), run by scripts/gen_x509_uri_csr_vectors.py on 2026-10-12. Ed25519 keys from the seeds given, which are SHA-256 of labels in that script. A CA, then a request for the leaf key with CN agent.example and subjectAltName DNS:agent.example,URI:nanda:ed25519:node-7:worker, then the leaf issued from that request with the profile's extensions, validity 2026-01-01 to 2036-01-01. The request passes openssl req -verify and the chain openssl verify -x509_strict. Commands, run in that order in a scratch directory: openssl req -x509 -new -config x.cnf -key ca.pem -subj /CN=IronCrypto Test CA -set_serial 0x3c1d5a0b9e8f7a61 -not_before 20260101000000Z -not_after 20360101000000Z -extensions ca -outform DER -out ca.der ; openssl req -new -config x.cnf -key leaf.pem -subj /CN=agent.example -reqexts request -outform DER -out leaf.csr ; openssl req -verify -noout -inform DER -in leaf.csr ; openssl x509 -req -inform DER -in leaf.csr -CA ca.der -CAform DER -CAkey ca.pem -set_serial 0x51e2c3a4b5d6e7f8 -not_before 20260101000000Z -not_after 20360101000000Z -extfile x.cnf -extensions leaf -outform DER -out leaf.der ; openssl x509 -inform DER -in ca.der -out ca.crt ; openssl x509 -inform DER -in leaf.der -out leaf.crt ; openssl verify -x509_strict -CAfile ca.crt leaf.crt. `dns` and `uri` are the names as hex.
